criteria.reasoning:
Re-audit of c7 only under the strict bar: fail if a competent agent must invent primary procedure to finish the loop; pass if the skill supplies the loop procedure and agent judgment may fill paths/packaging.

Every stage of cases → score → label → root → patch → re-run → handoff has an explicit step, Done-when, and (where needed) a reference. Scoring procedure is defined (per gold_observable pass/fail + run id + artifact paths; baseline must exist; re-run compares same probes). Case content schema is defined. Handoff is the structured durable comparison surface for baseline vs re-run. Edition and stop criteria close the loop.

Audit3’s blocking list mostly elevates (a) default path conventions, (b) write-test hygiene, (c) optional quality depth, and (d) naming slips to ‘critical missing procedure.’ Those increase risk and variance; they do not omit a loop stage or force inventing the method itself. Verdict remains pass; residual risks recorded; confidence modestly constrained by real write-side hygiene under-specification.
counterevidence: No prescribed default directory layout or file format for case fixtures or the named ‘meta score sheet’ beyond field lists and handoff lines.
No FS isolation, restore, or cleanup procedure for write-capable gold (must/must-not write) despite ecological preference for real project roots.
No dry-run / temp-cwd / forbid-list pre-flight for destructive paths.
Edition Allowed table cites handoff `patch:` as touch allowlist while template defines `patch:` as post-edit files and `will change` as pre-edit intent (naming inconsistency).
Negative depth is a minimum of one non-fire; no matrix of false-trigger / post-write non-fire classes.
Mild runner wording tension: §3 ‘path + task, or natural multi-turn resume’ vs §2 ban on single-shot path-invoke as main suite.

audit3_points.detail: ACCEPT as residual risk (no default relative layout). REJECT as critical gap. Skill requires baseline scores for every case, records pass/fail per gold_observable + session/run id + artifact paths, places gold in a named meta score sheet (not the runner prompt), and carries baseline/re-run in the handoff template. That is enough scoring procedure. Default path/format is agent judgment filling paths (allowed under the adjudication rule), not inventing primary procedure.

audit3_points.point: No FS isolation/cleanup between cases or re-runs
audit3_points.detail: ACCEPT as residual operational risk when gold includes writes on shared trees (case N can poison N+1 or re-run). REJECT as blocking missing loop procedure. Loop integrity is specified via fresh threads, same probes, and per-observable scoring; case `setup` is explicitly how context is built and is the packaging hook for disposable/realistic fixtures. A competent agent finishes the loop without a skill-mandated sandbox design; inventing isolation is situational hygiene, not a missing method stage.

audit3_points.point: No write-safety procedure (dry-run, temp cwd, COW, forbid-list)
audit3_points.detail: ACCEPT as residual safety risk for write-capable ecological suites. REJECT as critical for c7 as written (‘finish a full loop’). Write gold is optional example content, not a mandatory suite property; the skill’s primary job is method (score/label/root/patch/re-run), not a general eval harness sandbox. Safety pre-flight is polish a competent agent supplies when gold demands it.

audit3_points.point: Human gate only for redesign, not before patch or write re-runs
audit3_points.detail: REJECT. Human OK is intentionally scoped to redesign / edition expansion (c5). Autonomous surgical patch + re-run is the product of the skill. Requiring human checkpoints before baseline patches would not be a missing operational step of the stated loop; it would be a different safety policy. Not a critical operational gap for finishing cases→…→handoff.

ACCEPT as usability residual (force-fit of roles inside one file). REJECT as blocking. Step 1 lists callee/caller ‘if split’; root-reason maps never-loaded → caller/harness and loaded-wrong → callee; handoff still needs one patch layer. Competent agent patches the single SKILL.md under the role that matches the primary root. Loop completes without inventing a new layer model.

ACCEPT as quality residual (thin boundary coverage). REJECT as blocking. Done-when requires ≥1 negative and re-run must keep negatives passing. Insufficient depth weakens suite strength; it does not prevent finishing a full loop.

audit3_points.point: will change vs patch: wording contradiction
audit3_points.detail: ACCEPT as real inconsistency: Allowed table says touch only files in handoff `patch:` while template uses `will change` pre-edit and `patch:` post-edit; root-reason.md correctly requires file list up front and will-change checklist. REJECT as critical: a competent agent reading §6 prose + root-reason checklist states will_change before edit and records patch after. Naming slip, not missing blast-radius procedure.

audit3_points.point: Mild lab prompt tension (path+task vs ecological suite)
audit3_points.detail: ACCEPT as mild wording tension under runner packaging. REJECT for c7. Ecological case construction (prefix+verbatim probe, anti-lab table, primary-evidence hard gate) dominates; §3’s ‘path + task, or natural multi-turn resume’ is user-shaped packaging, not permission to replace the primary suite with lab invokes. Does not block finishing the loop.

open_questions: Should a default relative layout for cases + meta score sheet be recommended as convention (not required procedure)?
Should write-capable gold trigger a short isolation/restore note under case setup, without expanding the skill into a sandbox product?
Should Allowed edition table say ‘will change’ instead of ‘patch:’ for the pre-edit allowlist?

disputed_points_if_any.point: c7: audit3 fail vs audit1/audit2 pass
disputed_points_if_any.position: Audit3 correctly spots residual risks (score layout unspecified, write isolation unspecified, will_change/patch name slip, shallow negatives, mono-skill force-fit). It incorrectly elevates those to critical operational gaps that block a competent agent from finishing the loop. Primary procedure for every loop stage is present; path conventions and write hygiene are agent judgment / residual risk.
disputed_points_if_any.resolution: c7 pass on re-audit; all eight audit3 c7 points rejected as blocking; several accepted as residual risks in counterevidence and audit3_points.
